subject.title: feat(memory): graduate sessionMemory from experimental — solve the multi-session continuity problem

question: Should OpenClaw graduate session transcript indexing from `experimental.sessionMemory` to a stable or default-on memory source now, or keep it experimental until the open visibility, duplicate-indexing, ranking, privacy, and cost criteria are resolved?
rationale: The code path exists, but making it stable/default-on chooses product defaults and privacy boundaries for raw transcript recall; automation should not decide that policy from source availability alone.

options.title: Keep Experimental Until Blockers Resolve
options.body: Leave the feature opt-in while maintainers resolve gateway-dispatched session recall, duplicate-indexing guidance, ranking/source policy, privacy scope, and cost docs.

options.title: Graduate Stable But Opt-In
options.body: Remove the experimental framing without changing defaults, after adding explicit source labels, visibility docs, and upgrade guidance.

options.title: Default On For New Installs
options.body: Make session transcript recall a new-install default only after live proof and privacy/security review confirm DM/group/cross-channel behavior and cost expectations.

recommendation.title: Keep Experimental Until Blockers Resolve
recommendation.body: Leave the feature opt-in while maintainers resolve gateway-dispatched session recall, duplicate-indexing guidance, ranking/source policy, privacy scope, and cost docs.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history across memory docs/runtime surfaces and has prior review context on broad memory/context issues.
